hotspots.title: Vox 29N Campaign Launch & Remigration Push
hotspots.blurb: Vox's aggressive campaign ahead of Spain's November 29 elections has triggered sharp political friction, centered on hardline calls for national priority and 'remigration'. Campaign events in Catalonia and Navarre faced violent protests and bleach attacks, while party leader Santiago Abascal issued stern warnings regarding post-election negotiations with the People's Party.
hotspots.affect: The campaign blends inflammatory anti-immigrant rhetoric with reports of violent leftist pushback, driving intense grievance and mobilization across right-wing channels.

hotspots.title: RN Headquarters Raided in State Leaks Probe
hotspots.blurb: Investigations into confidential leaks from France's Interior Ministry to Marine Le Pen's Rassemblement National (RN) have intensified following judicial searches at party headquarters. A former regional prefect and senior officials face questioning over allegations of systematically supplying sensitive judicial intelligence to far-right leadership.
hotspots.affect: The probe fuels deep ideological warfare between state institutions and the far right, sparking allegations of deep-state infiltration from critics and political persecution from RN allies.

hotspots.title: Jair Bolsonaro Hospitalized with Severe Intestinal Obstruction
hotspots.blurb: Former Brazilian President Jair Bolsonaro was rushed to a Brasília hospital with acute abdominal pain, where CT scans revealed a near-total intestinal obstruction linked to his 2018 stabbing. As medical teams attempt non-surgical procedures to clear the blockage, conservative outlets report closely on his health alongside ongoing legal pressure from Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes against his family.
hotspots.affect: The life-threatening medical emergency surrounding the movement's leader commands maximum emotional investment and defensive alarm across bolsonarista media.

hotspots.title: AfD Pushes Early Premier Vote in Saxony-Anhalt
hotspots.blurb: The Alternative for Germany (AfD) in Saxony-Anhalt is forcing an early vote for Minister-President in early December, seeking to surprise rival parties and force CDU delegates to break the political 'firewall'. Lead candidate Ulrich Siegmund expressed confidence that secret balloting could yield the AfD its first-ever state executive victory.
hotspots.affect: The tactical maneuver creates severe anxiety over the potential breach of Germany's democratic cordon sanitaire and the rise of far-right governance.

hotspots.title: Milei Triumphs as Tesla Launches in Argentina
hotspots.blurb: Argentine President Javier Milei spearheaded the official arrival of Tesla in Buenos Aires, celebrating with a customized lion-emblazoned Cybertruck alongside a virtual appearance by Elon Musk. Milei seized the showcase to celebrate deregulation, asserting that removing state intervention is fulfilling his promise of economic freedom.
hotspots.affect: The event functions as a high-visibility victory lap for libertarian ideology, combining techno-capitalist hype with anti-state populism.
